text:
Type: stoneware pillar candle holder
Use: holding a pillar candle; on a mantel, shelf or table; living room, dining room
Style: farmhouse, rustic, traditional
Materials: glossy glazed stoneware, unglazed speckled clay base
Colors: white with blue speckles, warm clay beige
Shape: short turned baluster column, round drip tray top, round stepped flared base, compact and sturdy
Feel: warm, cozy, crafted
Goes with: natural wood, linen, cream and blue tones; farmhouse or cottage rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Rustic Farmhouse Stoneware Pillar Candle Decor Holder - 8 Inch, White and Clay
product.description: Different glazing techniques are used to create the two-tone effect of this candle holder. With classic and rustic touches, it holds 3" diameter candles or simply serves as a decorative piece. Allow for variations in color, as each is one of a kind. Off-white with blue speckles on the top, earth-tone clay color on base 100% stoneware. Glazing techniques produce a variegated color effect. 4.25"W x 4.25"D x 7.9"H Sturdy, durable piece for display or holding candles
